home.ctaTitle: Ready to Find Your Best Colors?
home.ctaSubtitle: Discover your perfect color palette with AI. Free, instant, no signup required.
home.faq1A: Personal color analysis (also called seasonal color analysis) is a method of finding the colors that best complement your natural coloring – skin tone, eye color, and hair color. When you wear your best colors, your skin looks healthier, your features stand out, and you look more vibrant overall. The system categorizes people into seasonal types (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter) with sub-types for more precision.
home.faq2Q: How does AI color analysis work?
home.faq2A: Our AI uses computer vision to analyze key color signals from your photo: skin undertone (warm, cool, or neutral), depth (how light or dark your overall coloring is), contrast (the difference between your lightest and darkest features), and chroma (how muted or saturated your coloring is). These measurements are compared against the 12-season color system to find your best match.
home.faq3A: Yes. Our AI has been trained on thousands of professional color analyses and achieves results comparable to in-person consultations for most people. For best accuracy, use a clear photo in natural daylight with no makeup or filters. People with ambiguous coloring between two seasons may benefit from trying both palettes.
home.faq4Q: Do I need to upload a photo?
home.faq4A: For AI analysis, yes – a clear selfie in natural light gives the most accurate results. If you prefer not to upload a photo, you can take our free color analysis quiz instead, which asks questions about your features to determine your season.
home.faq5Q: What will I learn from my color analysis?
home.faq5A: You'll discover your seasonal color type (e.g., Soft Autumn, Bright Winter), get a personalized palette of your most flattering colors, learn which colors to avoid, and receive specific recommendations for makeup shades, clothing colors, hair color, and jewelry metals.
home.faq6Q: How is this different from an in-person consultation?
home.faq6A: An in-person consultation with a professional colorist typically costs $200-$500 and takes 1-2 hours. Our AI analysis provides instant results based on the same color science principles. While professional draping remains the gold standard for complex cases, AI analysis gives accurate results for the majority of people and is an excellent starting point.

colorQuiz.title: Free Seasonal Color Analysis Quiz
colorQuiz.description: Answer 8 quick questions to discover whether you're a Spring, Summer, Autumn, or Winter color type.
colorQuiz.noAccount: No account required · Takes about 2 minutes
colorQuiz.q1: Look at the veins on your inner wrist. What color are they?
colorQuiz.q2: Which metal jewelry looks better on you?
colorQuiz.q3: When you spend time in the sun, your skin tends to:
colorQuiz.q4: Hold a pure white and an ivory/cream fabric next to your face. Which is more flattering?
colorQuiz.q4a: Pure white – it brightens my face
colorQuiz.q4c: Hard to tell, both seem fine
colorQuiz.q5: What best describes your natural eye color?
colorQuiz.q5a: Light blue, light gray, or light green
colorQuiz.q5d: Blue-gray, cool brown, or dark gray
colorQuiz.q6: What is your natural (undyed) hair color?
colorQuiz.q7: Look at the contrast between your skin, hair, and eyes. Is it:
colorQuiz.q7a: High contrast (e.g., dark hair + light skin)
colorQuiz.q7c: Low contrast (everything is similar in depth)
colorQuiz.q8: When you blush or exercise, your cheeks turn:
colorQuiz.result_spring_desc: You have warm undertones with a light, bright overall appearance. Your best colors are warm, clear, and lively – think golden yellows, coral, warm greens, and peach.
colorQuiz.result_spring_best: Coral, peach, warm pink, golden yellow, turquoise, warm green
colorQuiz.result_spring_avoid: Black, dark navy, cool gray, burgundy, icy pastels
colorQuiz.result_summer_desc: You have cool undertones with a soft, muted overall appearance. Your best colors are cool, gentle, and elegant – think dusty rose, lavender, soft blue, and sage.
colorQuiz.result_summer_best: Lavender, dusty rose, powder blue, soft teal, mauve, sage green
colorQuiz.result_summer_avoid: Orange, bright yellow, warm red, black, warm brown
colorQuiz.result_autumn_desc: You have warm undertones with a rich, muted overall appearance. Your best colors are warm, earthy, and deep – think rust, olive, mustard, and terracotta.
colorQuiz.result_autumn_best: Rust, olive, mustard, terracotta, warm brown, forest green
colorQuiz.result_autumn_avoid: Pastel pink, icy blue, bright white, fuchsia, cool gray
colorQuiz.result_winter_desc: You have cool undertones with a high-contrast, vivid overall appearance. Your best colors are bold, clear, and dramatic – think true red, emerald, royal blue, and black.
colorQuiz.result_winter_best: True red, royal blue, emerald, black, pure white, fuchsia
colorQuiz.result_winter_avoid: Warm brown, orange, muted tones, camel, warm beige

faceQuiz.title: Free Face Shape Quiz
faceQuiz.description: Answer 6 quick questions to discover your face shape and get personalized hairstyle recommendations.
faceQuiz.noAccount: No account required · Takes about 1 minute
faceQuiz.q1: How would you describe your forehead width compared to your jawline?
faceQuiz.q1a: My forehead and jawline are about the same width
faceQuiz.q1b: My forehead is wider than my jawline
faceQuiz.q1c: My jawline is wider than my forehead
faceQuiz.q1d: Both are narrow compared to my cheekbones
faceQuiz.q2: What is the shape of your jawline?
faceQuiz.q3: How would you describe the length vs width of your face?
faceQuiz.q4: Where is the widest part of your face?
faceQuiz.q6a: Very prominent – they're the widest point of my face
faceQuiz.result_oval_desc: Considered the most versatile face shape. Your face is slightly longer than wide, with a gently rounded jawline and forehead.
faceQuiz.result_oval_best: Lucky you – almost any hairstyle works! Try layered cuts, bobs, side parts, and both long and short styles.
faceQuiz.result_oval_avoid: Very heavy bangs that hide your balanced proportions.
faceQuiz.result_oval_bangs: Side-swept bangs, curtain bangs, or wispy bangs all work beautifully.
faceQuiz.result_round_desc: Your face has soft angles with similar width and length. Full cheeks and a rounded jawline give a youthful appearance.
faceQuiz.result_round_best: Long layers, side parts, asymmetrical bobs, and styles with height at the crown to elongate your face.
faceQuiz.result_round_avoid: Chin-length bobs, center parts, and very rounded styles that emphasize width.
faceQuiz.result_round_bangs: Side-swept or diagonal bangs. Avoid blunt, straight-across bangs.
faceQuiz.result_square_desc: Strong jawline with a forehead that's roughly the same width. Your face has angular, defined features.
faceQuiz.result_square_best: Soft layers, waves, side-swept styles, and anything that softens the angles. Long bobs and textured cuts work great.
faceQuiz.result_square_avoid: Blunt, one-length cuts and chin-length bobs that emphasize the jawline.
faceQuiz.result_square_bangs: Side-swept bangs or soft, wispy bangs. Avoid blunt straight bangs.
faceQuiz.result_heart_desc: A wider forehead and cheekbones that taper to a narrower, sometimes pointed chin. Often considered very feminine.
faceQuiz.result_heart_best: Chin-length bobs, long side-swept layers, and styles with volume at the jaw level to balance the narrower chin.
faceQuiz.result_heart_avoid: Styles with lots of volume at the crown or forehead, which emphasize the wider top.
faceQuiz.result_heart_bangs: Curtain bangs or side-swept bangs that soften the forehead width.
faceQuiz.result_oblong_desc: Your face is noticeably longer than it is wide, with a similar forehead and jawline width.
faceQuiz.result_oblong_best: Shoulder-length cuts, waves and curls that add width, side parts, and layered styles.
faceQuiz.result_oblong_avoid: Very long straight hair and styles that add height, which make the face appear longer.
faceQuiz.result_oblong_bangs: Full, blunt bangs to visually shorten the face length.
faceQuiz.result_diamond_desc: Narrow forehead and jawline with wide, high cheekbones. Angular and dramatic features.
faceQuiz.result_diamond_best: Chin-length bobs, side-swept styles, and cuts that add width at the forehead and chin level.
faceQuiz.result_diamond_avoid: Styles that are very narrow at the sides or add volume only at the cheekbones.
faceQuiz.result_diamond_bangs: Side-swept bangs or curtain bangs to add width at the forehead.
faceQuiz.result_triangle_desc: A narrower forehead that widens at the jawline and chin area.
faceQuiz.result_triangle_best: Styles with volume at the top – layered crowns, side parts with lift, and chin-length or shorter styles.
faceQuiz.result_triangle_avoid: Styles that add volume at the jaw level, heavy one-length cuts.
faceQuiz.result_triangle_bangs: Full, voluminous bangs or side-swept bangs to balance the narrower forehead.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Belle AI ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and website.
privacy.section1Content: We collect the following types of information:
privacy.section1Item1: Photos you upload for analysis (processed in real-time and not stored on our servers after analysis is complete)
privacy.section1Item2: Account information if you sign in (name, email address, profile picture from Google Sign-In)

privacy.section6Content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can delete your account at any time through the app settings. You can request a copy of your data by contacting us.
privacy.section7Content: Our services are not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
privacy.section8Content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.
privacy.section9Content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@aicoloranalysis.io.
